title: feat(ui): add DialogHeader and DialogFooter compositions
author: fisventurous
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #14934

adds standard header and footer compositions to the Dialog primitive and migrates community-endpoint-dialog
\- export `DialogHeader`, `DialogFooter`, and `DialogDescription` from `@pollinations/ui`
\- support rest props on header and footer wrappers
\- add rendering tests for dialog compositions and attribute pass-through in controls-accessibility
\- migrate `CommunityEndpointDialog` in enter to use the new header and footer compositions

closes #11920

gist.headline: Dialogs get bookends
gist.blurb: The dialog garden grew a proper header and footer, so titles, descriptions, and actions can settle into their natural habitats. Community endpoints have already moved into the tidier new layout.
gist.summary: Added exported DialogHeader, DialogFooter, and DialogDescription compositions to @pollinations/ui, including rest-prop support and rendering coverage, then migrated enter’s CommunityEndpointDialog to use them.
gist.impact: Developers can build consistent accessible dialogs with standard title, description, and action regions, while the community-endpoint dialog now uses the shared layout primitives.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy shared dialog component is represented as a little greenhouse-like pixel window with a clearly labeled top header awning, a description card in the middle, and a footer shelf holding action buttons. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, carefully arranges the window sections while code-plants and flowers grow around it, making the new reusable composition feel orderly and welcoming.
